children: : Prices of meat, poultry, and dairy products experienced mixed movements on Tuesday, September 8, according to data from the Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC).
White poultry rose by 0.6% daily to EGP 77.4 per kilogram, while the meat’s price edged down by 0.9% to EGP 441.6 per kilogram.
Tilapia fish was priced at EGP 87.1 per kilogram, falling by 3.7% daily.
The price of a liter of packaged milk amounted to EGP 45.4, marking a daily drop of 1.8% daily. On the other hand, a carton of white eggs rose by 3.5% to EGP 103.

title: ZAWYA: Egypt: Prices of white poultry, meat, dairy products varied on September 8
